scope: Regression addresses; execution results are recorded in the handoff.

regressions.test: restore is repeatable and does not remove restored or newly replaced links
restore reports a conflicting user replacement and can be retried
a failure immediately after a quarantine move still leaves a recovery journal
a failed release copy leaves the old release and state active
invalid or incomplete payloads are refused before installation changes
an existing different release is not silently reused under the same version
marketplace failure prevents legacy removal and shadow cleanup
a successful plugin command must register the requested version before cleanup
uninstall clears installed state, disables automatic reinstallation and is repeatable
uninstall reports plugin failure and keeps the marketplace for a retry
invalid state is not overwritten by mutating commands
unsupported flags are rejected before uninstall or restore can mutate anything
a failed current switch never changes plugins or installation state
update preserves config and registry observations written while plugins run
status prefers the active release over stale bookkeeping
update follows an existing symlinked agent channel
hook: missing publisher or malformed maintainer never authorizes an update
probe rejects valid-looking stdout when npm exits with an error
hook: missing npx does not fail the session or leave an update running
hook: future timestamps do not suppress probes or updates indefinitely
uninstall refuses a successful CLI result that leaves the plugin registered
